activityVerification.evidence: Radio Nano's official site exposes a live radio player, current May 2026 news and privacy-policy updates, and event listings dated June, July and August 2026. The official About page identifies the station as an Oslo-based web broadcaster established in 2016.

genreFitEvidence: Radio Nano describes its current format as great hits and pop classics and presents itself as a contemporary hit-oriented web station.
The station's 2026 event coverage includes Awakenings and Creamfields, supporting an electronic and dance context.

An accessible MarcsMusic electronic-pop, dance-pop, EDM-crossover or melodic world-fusion track has plausible fit; heavier or experimental bass material should not be assumed suitable without a human format check.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is free, first-party and explicitly open to international acts, but it carries a rights-and-clearance obligation, leaves technical, content, release and AI-origin rules unpublished, and presented a browser-verification screen during passive access. Human review and manual submission are mandatory.

notes: One new Radio Nano opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No email, form field, browser-verification challenge, audio file, attachment, link, biography, rights affirmation, login, CAPTCHA or payment was submitted.
